name: Aditya Spinners Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Aditya Spinners Ltd 
is in the business of  manufacture and sale 
of yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Company is in the field of blended yarn in medium and fined count segment with specialized products, viz.
a) Silk Yarn
b) Polyester Yarn
c) Weaving Yarn
d) Cotton Yarn
e) Woolen Yarn
f) Staple Yarn

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.61% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.67% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.55 Cr.
